column1: # GW5 (m1): how Ubuntu reads each file (Python's configparser as MetaRelease._parse_cfg: error = the file is ignored,
# none = no Prompt in [DEFAULT], value:<Prompt lowercased, newline as \n>), what host/data/release-upgrades-helper's
# set-prompt does with it as the main file (ok, or parse = refused and the file kept), and whether the helper names
# it as a release-upgrades.d override (yes, no, or unjudged: a lone CR or a Unicode space outside a comment line).
